title: Field fibre homology preservation
statement: theorem single_field_fibre_homology {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d) (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))) (i r : ℕ) (hzero : ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero (P.homology q)) (hrank : (P.homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r) {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (hR : IsField R) (f : Spec R ⟶ Y) : let Q := ((Modules.pullback f).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P (∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero (Q.homology q)) ∧ (Q.homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r

proof.text: Compare the pulled-back finite free complex with the original complex after tensoring to the field; flatness preserves the single cohomology and its rank.

mathlib_searches.query: derived fibre of a bounded finite free complex with single locally free cohomology is homotopy equivalent to a single vector space
finite free cochain complex local homotopy equivalence single complex residue cohomology
mathlib_searches.results: CochainComplex.IsKProjective.nonempty_homotopy_zero, CochainComplex.IsKInjective.nonempty_homotopy_zero, CochainComplex.cm5b.homotopyEquiv; no scheme residue normal-form theorem.
